Name: PRODUCE FLAME
Main Effect:
You conjure a small flickering flame in the palm of your hand, illuminating a **15-meter (50-foot)** area around it.

Dropping the flame extinguishes it.
Secondary Effect: You can spend 2 Action Points and 4 Willpower to hurl the flame at **an entity** you can see within **15 meters (50 feet)**. Make a {stat} Ranged Attack {roll}. On a hit, you deal [[3d6 + 3*stat]] {damage} damage.

Name: CLOAK OF FLAMES
Main Effect:
You envelop yourself in a fiery cloak that lasts for **5 turns**.

Entities having their Turn Start within **1.5 meters (5 feet)** of you take [[stat]] {damage} damage.
Secondary Effect:
You can spend 2 Action Points and 4 Willpower to make the cloak flare outward.

**All entities** within **3 meters (10 feet)** of you are inflicted with Burn.

Name: KINDLE WEAPON
Main Effect:
You imbue a weapon you can touch with flames.

When the imbued weapon lands a hit, its damage is Empowered by 1 and the damage type becomes {damage:Fire}.
Secondary Effect: At your Turn Start, pay 1 Willpower to keep the weapon kindled. Miss the Upkeep and the spell ends.

Name: FIRE SEED
Main Effect:
You embed a seed of elemental fire in **an entity** you can see within **9 meters (30 feet)**. The target is unaware unless it saw you cast.

The seed lasts **until the target takes a Long Rest**, and while it does you know its direction.
Secondary Effect: If you have any active Fire Seed, you may pay 3 Action Points and 4 Willpower to detonate. Every seed explodes, dealing [[3d6 + 3*stat]] {damage} damage to its target and **any entities** within **4.5 meters (15 feet)**.

Name: MOLTEN GRASP
Main Effect: You ignite your hands, melting metal and stone with your touch for **5 turns**. For the duration, you can melt up to **1.5 square meters (5 square feet)** of metal on a surface up to **15 cm (6 inches)** thick.
Secondary Effect: You can spend 2 Action Points and 3 Willpower to transfer the heat into a metallic object. For the rest of the duration, entities in contact with the object at their Turn Start take [[2d6 + 2*stat]] {damage} damage.

Name: WALL OF FLAMES
Main Effect:
You conjure a wall of fire at a location you can see within **15 meters (50 feet)**.

The wall is **15 meters (50 feet)** long and **2 meters (6 feet)** thick, and it does not have to be a straight line. The wall blocks line of sight.

**Any entity** passing through the wall or having their Turn Start within it takes [[4d6 + 4*stat]] {damage} damage.

Name: BLAZING SUNS
Main Effect: You conjure 4 small spheres of fire that hover around you, illuminating **15 meters (50 feet)** for **3 hours**.
Secondary Effect:
Whenever you deal damage or heal, you can spend 1 Willpower to expend one of your spheres.

Doing so increases the damage or healing by [[2*stat]] {damage} damage when applicable.

Name: CAUTERIZE
Main Effect:
You use swift and intense heat to cauterize the wound of **an entity** you can see within **9 meters (30 feet)**.

The target takes [[2d6 + 2*stat]] {damage} damage and then regains [[5d6 + 5*stat]] Health. This removes any Bleed or Poison effect.
Secondary Effect: When casting this spell, you may spend an additional 1 Action Point and 3 Willpower any number of times. For each time you do, target **an additional eligible entity**.

Name: RAIN OF FIRE
Main Effect:
You call down a rain of fire in a **12-meter (40-foot)** radius on a point you can see within **30 meters (100 feet)**.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against the Reflex of **all entities** in the area. On a success, you deal [[4d6 + 4*stat]] {damage} damage, or half as much on a failure. Another wave falls at your Turn Start while you pay the Upkeep.
Secondary Effect: At your Turn Start, pay 3 Willpower to keep the rain falling. Miss the Upkeep and the spell ends.

Name: CONTROL WATER
Main Effect:
You gain control over water within **3 meters (10 feet)** for the next **1 hour**, in the following ways:

Create Currents: currents move objects and entities at a speed of your choice, up to **18 meters (60 feet)** per turn.

Water Tension: targets of your choice can walk on water.

Part Water: you part a body of water in a sphere around you, letting you walk underwater.
Image: NOVICE SPELL - ELEMENTAL - WATER - CONTROL WATER.jpg

Name: CREATE WATER
Main Effect: You condense the moisture in the air. You create up to 2 liters (0.5 gallons) of water in an open container or on a surface you can see within **9 meters (30 feet)**.
Secondary Effect: If there is at least 1 liter (0.25 gallons) of water within **9 meters (30 feet)**, you may spend 3 Action Points and 1 Willpower. You hurl the water as a high-pressure beam at **an entity** in that range. Make a {stat} Ranged Attack {roll}. On a hit, you deal [[2d6 + 2*stat]] {damage} damage.
Image: NOVICE SPELL - ELEMENTAL - WATER - CREATE WATER.jpg

Name: ICE ARMOR
Main Effect:
You coat your body in a layer of protective frost that lashes out when shattered.

You gain [[2d6 + 2*stat]] Shield.

When an attack causes you to lose Shield, an ice spike immediately fires at the attacker if they are within **9 meters (30 feet)** and you can see them. The target takes [[1d6 + stat]] {damage} damage.
Image: NOVICE SPELL - ELEMENTAL - WATER - ICE ARMOR.jpg

Name: DRAIN FLUIDS
Main Effect:
You reach out to siphon the internal fluids of **an entity** you can see within **9 meters (30 feet)**.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against its Grit. On a success, the target takes [[2d6 + 2*stat]] {damage} damage, and then again at each of your Turn Starts.
Secondary Effect: At your Turn Start, pay 2 Willpower to keep siphoning. Miss the Upkeep and the spell ends. The spell also ends if you cannot see the target at your Turn Start.
Image: ADEPT SPELL - ELEMENTAL - WATER - DRAIN FLUIDS.jpg

Name: FLASH FREEZE
Main Effect:
You release a sudden burst of freezing water to encase **an entity** you can see within **9 meters (30 feet)** in a thin layer of ice.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against the target’s Reflex. On a success, the target’s next Action is prevented.

This effect ends once the target attempts to take an Action.
Image: ADEPT SPELL - ELEMENTAL - WATER - FLASH FREEZE.jpg

Name: TIDAL WAVE
Main Effect:
You create and send a tidal wave crashing onto your foes.

The wave starts at a point you can see within **24 meters (80 feet)** and moves **12 meters (40 feet)** in a direction of your choice. It is **9 meters (30 feet)** wide and **3 meters (10 feet)** tall.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against the Grit of **all entities** caught in its path. On a success, the entity is pushed **12 meters (40 feet)**.

If they encounter an obstacle before they are moved the full distance, they take [[3d6 + 3*stat]] {damage} damage.
Image: ADEPT SPELL - ELEMENTAL - WATER - TIDAL WAVE.jpg

Name: GLACIAL ACCRETION
Main Effect:
For the next **5 turns**, you manifest a freezing aura that crystallizes your spent energy into jagged shards of ice.

Every 2 Willpower you spend forms an Ice Spike that orbits you, up to half your {mind}.
Secondary Effect: You may spend 3 Action Points to hurl all active Ice Spikes at **an entity** you can see within **18 meters (60 feet)**. Make a {mind} Ranged Attack {roll}. On a hit, you deal [[1d6 + mind]] {damage} damage for each Ice Spike consumed.
Image: MASTER  SPELL - ELEMENTAL - WATER - GLACIAL ACCRETION.jpg

Name: ICE BLOCK
Main Effect:
You condense water and freeze it around **an entity** you can see within **18 meters (60 feet)**.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against the target’s Reflex. On a success, the entity is encased in ice, becoming stunned and immune to all non-{damage:Psychic} damage.
Secondary Effect: At your Turn Start, pay 4 Willpower to keep the ice frozen. Miss the Upkeep and the spell ends.
Image: MASTER  SPELL - ELEMENTAL - WATER - ICE BLOCK.jpg

Name: WATER VORTEX
Main Effect:
You manifest a swirling vortex of water at a point you can see within **9 meters (30 feet)** that lasts for **10 turns (1 minute)**. The vortex has a **15-meter (50-foot)** radius and is Difficult Terrain.

At **each entity**’s Turn Start within the area, make a {stat} Roll {roll} against its Grit. On a success, the entity is pulled **9 meters (30 feet)** toward the center of the vortex.

The roll takes 1 disadvantage against entities **3 meters (10 feet)** tall or more, and 1 more for every **1.5 meters (5 feet)** over it.
Image: MASTER  SPELL - ELEMENTAL - WATER - WATER VORTEX.jpg

Name: AIR CONTROL
Main Effect:
You control air density in a **15-meter (50-foot)** area centered on yourself.

When you cast it, you choose to make the air:

Dense: Doubling the Action Point cost of the {{Move}} action for **all entities** within range and granting them the Slow Fall effect for **10 turns (1 minute)**.

Light: Increases **all entities**’ Movement Speed by 3. Outside of combat, it increases how much you can travel by foot by 50%.
Image: NOVICE SPELL - ELEMENTAL - AIR - AIR CONTROL.jpg

Name: FLING
Main Effect:
You use strong force to instantly displace yourself to a point you can see within **15 meters (50 feet)**.

If you would collide with an obstacle before reaching your destination, you stop and take [[6d6]] {damage} damage.
Secondary Effect: When casting this spell, you may spend an additional 1 Action Point and 1 Willpower any number of times. For each time you do, target **an additional entity** within touch: it moves the same distance in the same direction.

Name: WIND BLADE
Main Effect:
You launch a sharp wind blade at **an entity** you can see within **15 meters (50 feet)**.

Make a {stat} Ranged Attack {roll}. On a hit, you deal [[2d6 + stat]] {damage} damage.
Image: NOVICE SPELL - ELEMENTAL - AIR - WIND BLADE.jpg

Name: HURL
Main Effect:
You create a strong gust of wind in an attempt to hurl **an entity** you can see within **9 meters (30 feet)**.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against the target’s Grit. On a success, the entity is moved **9 meters (30 feet)** in a direction of your choice.

If the entity collides with **another entity**, both take [[2d6 + 2*stat]] {damage} damage and the movement stops.

Name: LIGHTNING STRIKE
Main Effect:
You call down lightning to strike a point you can see within **9 meters (30 feet)**.

If the space is occupied by **an entity**, make a {stat} Roll {roll} against its Reflex. On a success, you deal [[2d6 + 2*stat]] {damage} damage, or half as much on a failure.

If you used Lightning Strike in the last **12 hours**, the last point you struck with lightning is also struck.
Image: NOVICE SPELL - ELEMENTAL - LIGHTNING - LIGHTNING STRIKE.jpg

Name: VOLTAIC JOLT
Main Effect:
You turn into pure energy and instantly teleport yourself to a point you can see within **6 meters (20 feet)**.

**All entities** in a line between your start and end point take [[1d6 + stat]] {damage} damage.
Secondary Effect: You can spend 1 Action Point and 2 Willpower to teleport any number of entities you can touch along with you. They move the same distance parallel to you.
Image: ADEPT  SPELL - ELEMENTAL - LIGHTNING - LIGHTNING STRIKE.jpg

Name: GALVANIZE
Main Effect:
You infuse **an entity** you can touch with volatile electrical energy that reacts to impacts: it becomes Galvanized.

Whenever a Galvanized entity is hit, a spark erupts which deals an additional [[stat]] {damage} damage to them.
Secondary Effect: When casting this spell, you may spend an additional 1 Action Point and 4 Willpower any number of times. For each time you do, target **an additional eligible entity**.

Name: SLAG SHOT
Main Effect:
You fire a small orb of magma at **an entity** you can see within **15 meters (50 feet)**.

Make a {stat} Ranged Attack {roll}. On a hit, you deal [[1d6 + stat]] {damage} damage and the target is afflicted with Burn.
Secondary Effect: When casting this spell, you may spend an additional 1 Action Point and 1 Willpower any number of times. For each time you do, cast Slag Shot an additional time.
Image: NOVICE SPELL - ELEMENTAL - MAGMA- SLAG SHOT.jpg

Name: MAGMA CHAINS
Main Effect:
Chains made of magma erupt from the ground, binding **an entity** you can see within **6 meters (20 feet)**.

The entity is bound by 3 Chains. It can spend 2 Action Points to make a {physique} Roll against your {stat}: on a success it breaks 1 Chain, on a critical success 2.

While 3 Chains remain, the target is stunned and can only attempt to break Chains. While 2 or fewer Chains remain, the target is rooted.

At its Turn Start, the entity takes [[stat]] {damage} damage.
Image: ADEPT  SPELL - ELEMENTAL - MAGMA- MAGMA CHAINS.jpg

Name: MAGMA SURGE
Main Effect:
You flood a point you can see within **18 meters (60 feet)**, forming a **9-meter (30-foot)** magma pool that is Difficult Terrain.

**Any entity** entering the pool or with its Turn Start in it takes [[3d6 + 3*stat]] {damage} damage.
Secondary Effect: At your Turn Start, pay 2 Willpower to keep the magma molten. Miss the Upkeep and the spell ends. When the spell ends, the magma solidifies and **all entities** in it become rooted **until their next Turn End**.
Image: MASTER SPELL - ELEMENTAL - MAGMA- MAGMA SLIDE.jpg

Name: SHAPE EARTH
Main Effect:
You reach out with your mind, causing earth, mud or stone to flow like thick liquid into a shape of your choosing.

You reshape a **3-meter (10-foot)** cube of earth or stone you can see within **9 meters (30 feet)** into a new form (such as a wall, a pillar or a simple stone object).

The object has a Defense equal to [[stat + level]] and Health equal to [[5*stat]].

Name: STONE BARRAGE
Main Effect:
You tear a stone loose from the ground and hurl it at **an entity** you can see within **12 meters (40 feet)**.

Make a {stat} Ranged Attack {roll}. On a hit, you deal [[2d6 + stat]] {damage} damage.
Secondary Effect: When casting this spell, you may spend an additional 1 Action Point and 1 Willpower any number of times. For each time you do, target **an additional eligible entity**.

Name: STONEFLESH
Main Effect:
Your skin hardens into a shell of packed stone.

You gain [[4d6 + 4*stat]] Shield. While the Shield holds, you cannot be moved against your will or knocked prone, you have resistance to physical damage and your Movement Speed is halved.

Name: TREMOR SENSE
Main Effect:
You extend your senses into the earth, sensing **all entities** within **18 meters (60 feet)** for **1 hour**.

While they touch the ground or stone you know their exact position and see them as silhouettes through walls and darkness, invisible ones included.

You ignore blinded and any other effect that would impair your vision.

Name: EARTH GLIDE
Main Effect:
You loosen the stone around you and pass through it like water at your Movement Speed for up to **20 meters (65 feet)**.

You cannot see while inside. If the spell ends while you are enclosed, you are pushed to the nearest open space and knocked prone.
Secondary Effect: When casting this spell, you may spend an additional 2 Action Points and 3 Willpower to bring **any entities** you can touch along with you.

Name: SINKHOLE
Main Effect:
The ground gives way in a **6-meter (20-foot)** area centered on a point you can see within **15 meters (50 feet)**.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against the Reflex of **all entities** in the area. On a success, the entity falls into the pit and is knocked prone.

The pit is **3 meters (10 feet)** deep and its walls are Difficult Terrain.

Name: MOUNTAIN’S WEIGHT
Main Effect:
You settle the weight of a mountain onto **an entity** you can see within **9 meters (30 feet)**.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against its Reflex. On a success, the target is constrained under a boulder.

The target or an ally can spend 6 Action Points to get it out from under the boulder.

Name: EARTHQUAKE
Main Effect:
You split an **18-meter (60-foot)** radius of ground you can see within **30 meters (100 feet)** into Difficult Terrain.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against the Grit of **all entities** in the area. On a success, you deal [[4d6 + 4*stat]] {damage} damage and they are knocked prone, or half as much on a failure. Inanimate ones take double.
Secondary Effect: At your Turn Start, pay 4 Willpower to break the ground again. Miss the Upkeep and the spell ends.

Name: AEGIS OF STONE
Main Effect: You raise 4 slabs of stone that orbit your body for **3 hours**.
Secondary Effect:
Whenever you take damage, you can spend 1 Willpower to expend one of your slabs.

Doing so reduces the damage taken by [[2d6 + 2*stat]].

Name: DOWNPOUR
Main Effect:
Driving rain falls in a **36-meter (120-foot)** radius on a point you can see within **18 meters (60 feet)** for **10 turns (1 minute)**.

Ranged Attacks made into or through the area have disadvantage, and any fire in the area is extinguished.

Name: HAILSTORM
Main Effect:
Hail falls in a **9-meter (30-foot)** radius on a point you can see within **24 meters (80 feet)**.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against the Reflex of **all entities** in the area. On a success, you deal [[2d6 + 2*stat]] {damage} damage, or half as much on a failure.

The ice left behind makes the area Difficult Terrain for **10 turns (1 minute)**.

Name: EYE OF THE STORM
Main Effect:
A storm opens around you for **10 turns (1 minute)**, calm within **3 meters (10 feet)** and violent out to **18 meters (60 feet)**. It moves with you.

**All entities** in the violent band have disadvantage on Attack Rolls, and take [[2d6 + 2*stat]] {damage} damage at each of their Turn Starts.
Secondary Effect: At your Turn Start, pay 4 Willpower to keep the storm turning. Miss the Upkeep and the spell ends.
